# ADR 0000: Template

**Status:** template — copy this file, do not edit it in place.

## Context

What is true right now that forces a decision. Constraints, not preferences.

## Decision

What was decided, in one or two sentences, in the active voice.

## Consequences

What this makes easy, what it makes hard, and what it forecloses. Include the cost of
reversing it — that cost is why the decision needed an ADR.

## Alternatives rejected

Each alternative with the specific reason it lost. "More complex" is not a reason;
"requires operating a service nobody is on call for" is.

---

ADRs are immutable once merged. A later ADR supersedes an earlier one and says so;
the earlier one is never edited, so the reasoning at the time stays legible.
